lines.t: Yeah, he walked the earth in love and grace
The word made flesh to take our place
He healed the sick, the blind could see
And cried, repent and follow me
Yahuwah gave his son to die
That none be lost, that life draw nigh
No endless pain, no hopeless cries
The wicked perish, truth defies
Reblooded, I'm gone forever
The proud shall fall, remember never
From dust we came, the dust returned
The fire refines, the child shall burn
The life he gives to all who hear
Yahushua's call so strong, so clear
Come to the light, escape the night
No torment waits, just death or life
The dead know nothing, still and cold
Not torture flames as we've been told
The wages paid for wicked ways and end of breath
No song is heard from the grave, the lake of fire
The second death where Yah withdraws His gift of breath
No life in pain, no scream, no song
To be no more, the early saints would never teach
A fiery hell no hand could reach
They spoke the truth with steadfast tone
The wicked fade, their breath is gone
Yahushua weeps for those astray
He calls them home, He is the way
He warns in love, turn and be wise
For sin shall burn and flame shall die
The blood had outgone forever
The proud shall fall, remember never
From dust we came to dust return
The fire refines, the chaff shall burn
But life begins to all who hear
Yeah, we'll just call so strong, so clear
But come to the light, escape the night
No torment awaits, just death or life
So fear the one who gives and takes
Who wakes the soul, whose mercy breaks
He longs to cleanse from every sin
But those who mock won't enter in
The book is open, hearts await
The righteous rise, the loathe your fate
So choose the life he came to call
Receive his flame, surrender all
From blooded out, gone forever
The proud shall fall, remembered never
From dust we came, the dust returned
The fire refines, the chaff shall burn
The light he gives to all who hear
Yahushua's call so strong, so clear
Welcome to the light, escape the night
No proven ways, just death or life
Just death or life
